description: This file is the main React application component for a web-based ICU Availability and Scheduling System. It manages routing via URL hash, theme toggling, tab navigation, and renders core components like Header, AvailabilityManager, ScheduleICU, and ScheduleManager.

methods.name: useHashRoute
methods.description: Custom hook that monitors URL hash to manage routing between '/' and '/schedule-manager'. Provides route state and navigation function.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component initializing theme, routing, tab navigation, and rendering the appropriate main content based on current route.
